messages:
maya: quick design check — thinking about keyboard-first access for the run history + tool outputs. proposal: single hotkey (/) opens the run search, K opens the most recent run, and then arrows navigate entries. expand tool output with Enter or Shift+Enter for multi-line.
adrian: nice. do we have a discovery affordance? users won't know K/Enter. maybe show a tiny hotkey pill in the header when they first focus the playground (dismissible). :bulb:
kevin: +1 for the pill. copy idea: instead of 'Expand' use 'Open output' to avoid modal confusion. shorter and clearer for screenreaders.
lina: accessibility nit — when an output panel expands it needs a programmatic focus target (role=region, aria-label="Tool output: {toolName}") otherwise screen readers skip. also ensure the focus trap is optional; users should be able to jump back to the run list with Escape.
maya: good call. let's capture minimal keymap in case we need to pass to eng:
```
/ -> open run search (focus input)
K -> open latest run (focus run item)
ArrowUp/ArrowDown -> move between runs
Enter -> expand selected run output (focus first interactive in panel)
Shift+Enter -> expand collapsed tool output in-place
Esc -> close panel or jump back to run list
```
adrian: one more UX detail: when you open an expanded tool output, show a subtle breadcrumb at top like "Run #123 · toolName" with a small chevron back button (keyboard focusable). that indicates context and gives a clear back target.
kevin: microcopy tweak suggestion for the breadcrumb back button: label it 'Back to run' instead of 'Back' so VoiceOver reads intent.
lina: color/contrast note — the default focus ring on the chevron is a 1px blue which fails 3:1. propose a 3px solid outline in our focus color tokens and an additional visible focus halo. I'll attach design tokens after this thread.
sam-bot: accessibility-checker report attached: https://ci.internal/reports/a11y/playground-run-history-1719987654 (low severity: missing aria-label on expand buttons, insufficient focus ring on chevron).
maya: thanks! action items: (1) add hotkey pill and first-time tooltip (devex + eng), (2) implement aria-label on expand buttons + region roles (eng), (3) update microcopy to 'Open output' and 'Back to run' (content), (4) update focus ring token (design). i'll spin a tiny spec doc and link it.
adrian: can you add a short e2e test that tabs through run list -> expand -> back? just to prevent regressions.
maya: yep, i'll add a Jest + Playwright snippet in the spec. finishing note: keep all toggles accessible by keyboard — we should avoid hover-only controls for tool calls.
